input_contract.required_matrix: nonnegative finite raw gene counts with positive total count for every admitted cell or nucleus

gene_axis.identity: OS_scRNA_gene_index.19264.tsv at the pinned code revision

input_contract.alignment: Intersect input genes with the exact 19,264-name list, append absent model genes, and reorder to the released axis. Duplicate or ambiguous identifiers must be resolved before alignment.
preprocessing: Compute total raw counts per cell.
Append two depth values, each max(log10(total_count), 5).
Use float32 on CPU and bfloat16 on CUDA under the official helper.
input_contract.attention_mask: The released alignment helper masks genes absent from the input panel and marks both depth positions observed. Preserve a separate project missingness state because the native tensor cannot distinguish every structural absence from an observed zero.

embedding_contract.official_standalone_recipe: CellFoundationModel last_hidden_state followed by attention-mask-weighted mean across admitted gene positions and both depth positions.
embedding_contract.common_lane: Freeze exact layer, inclusion of depth tokens, mask semantics, pooling, numeric precision, row order, and identical project head before screening.
embedding_contract.native_lane: A project classifier, adapter, LoRA, or full fine-tune is not admitted until institutional terms review. Any allowed derivative remains subject to the GenBio license and is not an open champion.
embedding_contract.warning: The HF example script defaults to GB.Cell-3M. A GB.Cell-100M benchmark run must override the model handle and record it in the run receipt.
